knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Equipment that has been in one system can carry organisms or residues into another even when it looks clean. The correct action is a dedicated net for the other system.
Only an aquarium product approved for the system, used under the owner's instruction and the label, is appropriate. Pool products are never used in an aquarium.
Chlorine and chloramine are removed from tap water before it enters the tank, at the label dose and as the owner's plan directs.

practicalCriteria: Learner sorts a mixed set of training equipment into freshwater, marine and dedicated labels, with no item assigned to two systems
Learner prepares conditioned water for a training tank, and records the source, the conditioner and the label dose used
Learner declines a pool chemical request in a role-play, and records the refusal and the referral
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Water preparation record with source, conditioner and label check
Refusal and referral record for a requested product
stopWorkCriteria: A request to add pool chemicals or any product not approved for the system
Tap water source unknown and no plan to check it with the water utility
Marine mix made by feel with no instrument available to check salinity
